dataset: Causal Chambers lt_malus_v1, original published white_255 measurements
license: CC BY 4.0 dataset; Gamella, Peters and Buhlmann (2025), doi:10.1038/s42256-024-00964-x
data_policy: Use existing author measurements only; no remote operation or synthetic replacement.
target: I_3, if the published sensor column uses an equivalent documented name retain and report that exact name
inputs: theta_1 and theta_2 converted from documented degrees to radians
selection: training BIC over these three predeclared templates only, never holdout
production_math: CAELUM typed expression evaluator and native conditioned QR; independent NumPy least squares comparison
interval: 95% split-conformal absolute calibration residuals for the selected fitted model
endpoints: all model holdout RMSE including losing models
selected model interval coverage and width
limits: This is a measured-data predictive evaluation of supplied physical templates, not automated discovery of Malus law or new physical causal proof. Publish all measured failures.
